Application Data.NAME: Tech Haven Electronics
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS:
1234 Circuit Blvd, Suite 200  
Tech City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Tech Haven Electronics specializes in the sale of consumer electronics, including smartphones, computers, and home entertainment systems. Additionally, we provide repair services for various electronic devices, including diagnostics, screen replacements, and software solutions. Our team is committed to offering high-quality products and reliable repair services to ensure customer satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a customer reported a defective smartphone that caused a minor injury due to battery overheating. The business promptly offered a refund and covered medical expenses totaling $2,000. Status: Closed. On June 22, 2023, a break-in resulted in stolen electronics valued at $3,000. Status: Under investigation.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system, regular security patrols, and reinforced entrance doors.
